title: Totems of Power
description: This is a mod that adds a bunch of totems for me and my friends/family.
body:
This is a mod that adds a bunch of equippable totems for me and my friends/family. If you do use this know that its kinda buggy and I add random stuff i wish was in Minecraft for my pleaseure. 

This mod uses Curious, Pehkui (heavily) and palladium for the totems.

This mod adds over 20 different totems to the game that you can equip. It also adds a new Curios slot specifically for my mod so that you can equip up to 4 totems at a time without interfering with other mods curios's.

There are also **_SUPERPOWER_** totems that you can equip but WILL NOT WORK without my addon that i will not be publishing.

You have basic totems such as the Totem of Perpetual Motion that will increase all movement speed, this includes elytra flight, falling, swimming, etc., and then you have more advanced totems such as the Totem of Cooling which will cool all nearbu lava sources making nether exploration way easier. But like i said before there are over 20 different ones and the combinations of specific totems to combat a situation can be fun. I would recommend adding a Difficulty mod for more fun.

Most totems are for niche circumstances that i found myself wanting to be easier but didn't
want to download a new mod.

With this mod you can also mine Mob Spawners and Budding Amethyst as long as you have silk touch because i felt like it :).
